name: Nuclear plant safety
summary: Zaporizhzhia lost all off-site power for the 16th time in 2026 on 8 Nov; IAEA warns on Ukraine's winter grid
state: Zaporizhzhia lost its last 330kV line on 8 Nov, its 16th complete loss of off-site power in 2026, leaving diesel generators to supply its own needs (Energoatom via Ukrainska Pravda). IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi told the Board on 18 Nov that it would be difficult to overstate his concern about Ukraine's grid as winter sets in (ANS, 19 Nov). Searches on 27 Nov found no damage to safety-critical systems, INES level 2 event or radiological release.
for_you: There is no radiological risk to the public reported. Anyone in Ukraine should follow national civil protection guidance; UK travellers should check FCDO travel advice for Ukraine.
rubric_hit: Watch: Zaporizhzhia lost all off-site power on 8 Nov; IAEA reports a deteriorating grid situation
